card.name: Russian space and education passages
card.fires_on: Ordinary words inside web passages about Russia, its space programme and its universities, such as 'of' after Republic, 'still' after Russia, or 'Agency' after Federal Space.

modes.label: Russian state names
modes.description: Words in or right after Russian place or agency names, where a state-style name continues.
modes.example: today the capital of the Republic<< of>> Tatarstan, to Osmaniye

modes.label: Space research prose
modes.description: Linking or verb words in sentences about Russian space strategy, exoplanets or rockets.
modes.example: Russia<< still>> considers exoplanet research as a potential

modes.description: Small words in text about Russian exams and university entry.

card.writes: It pushes names like Republic and Chinese words for republic, so it seems to add state-name endings.
card.plain: It lights up on everyday words in web articles about Russia, especially its space programme and government bodies.
